rationale.lab: D65/sRGB reference white and red use existing 0.01/0.03 Lab tolerances; black is zero. Red/blue Euclidean Lab distance is 176.314039, with 1e-6 tolerance for floating arithmetic.
rationale.raster: Authored opaque equal-area interiors define the HEX truth. White is background; black/gray require include_neutrals. Alpha 128 red over white gives (255,127,127); 400 red and 200 blue retained pixels imply 2/3 and 1/3 weights.
rationale.families: Eight fixed panels over five papers: a has three C0 blues and one red, b has D0, c has E0, d has red, e has two colors. Distinct C0/D0/E0 variants select D0 as medoid despite duplicate C0 panels. One-color denominators are four papers/seven panels; the two-color denominator is one/one. Journal/year counts count panels. Paper a contributes to both blue and red, so one-color prevalences sum to 1.25.
rationale.bootstrap: Compatibility projection for sorted paper IDs, default_rng seed 2021, 100 paper-level draws, 2.5/97.5 percentiles: all-used two-color papers give [1,1]; blue 3/4 gives [0.25,1]; red 2/4 gives [0,1].
rationale.recommendations: Two observed three-color families each occur in one of two papers. First white score = round(0.55*0.5 + 0.30*(16.97/30) + 0.15*(2.25/4.5),4) = 0.5197. Its identical reference has zero popularity and -0.05 penalty, giving 0.1947. Dark scores reflect current background contrast. Categorical collisions warn/filter; low contrast warns without exclusion. Simulated HEX arrays pin the current approximate full-dichromacy compatibility output, not accessibility certification.
rationale.references: Pin the authored current Okabe-Ito and Paul Tol bright arrays and current illustrative flowchart role assignments; these references have no observed corpus prevalence.
